name: setup-vite
title: Ultima setup for Vite
description: PROTOTYPE (ULT-8). components.json plus a vite.config.ts with the StyleX unplugin. Universal item: installs without Tailwind.
docs: Ultima on Vite: this replaced vite.config.ts with one that runs @stylexjs/unplugin before the React plugin and aliases @/ to src/. Add "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } to your tsconfig (the CLI needs it to place files), then run: npx shadcn add @ultima/button
